_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: history_one_value_update_per_day
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX history_one_value_update_per_day ON history_entries (investment_id, date) WHERE kind = 'value_update'

data.name: history_one_skip_per_plan_date
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX history_one_skip_per_plan_date ON history_entries (investment_id, kind, date) WHERE kind IN ('payout_skipped', 'value_skipped')

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "intent" TEXT NULL, "market" TEXT NULL, "market_country" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity" TEXT NULL, "purity_karat" INTEGER NULL, "purity_fineness" INTEGER NULL, "zakat_rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "custom_zakat_share" TEXT NULL, "inflation_override" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "payout_schedule" TEXT NULL, "expected_profit" TEXT NULL, "value_check_schedule" TEXT NULL, "expected_growth" TEXT NULL, "profit_basis" TEXT NULL, "capital_back" TEXT NULL, "account_kind" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "investment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES investments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "as_of" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("from_unit", "to_unit", "as_of", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inflation_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("country", "year"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_currency" TEXT NULL, "home_inflation" TEXT NULL, "zakat_year" TEXT NULL, "long_term_method" TEXT NULL, "jewellery_zakatable" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("jewellery_zakatable" IN (0, 1)), "nisab_metal" TEXT NULL, "reminder_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("reminder_on" IN (0, 1)), "reminder_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reminder_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 540, "reminder_asked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reminder_asked" IN (0, 1)), "giving_rate_view" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "no_zakat_years" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("year"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zakat_cycles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calendar" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("from_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zakat_years" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "moved_due" TEXT NULL, "debts" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', "deduct_debts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("deduct_debts" IN (0, 1)), "started_on" TEXT NULL, "frozen_base" TEXT NULL, "frozen_nisab_metal" TEXT NULL, "frozen_metal_rate" TEXT NULL, "frozen_metal_rate_date" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("due_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zakat_extra_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES zakat_years (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "good_debt_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("good_debt_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zakat_frozen_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES zakat_years (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "held_interest" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_date" TEXT NULL, "rate" TEXT NULL, "rate_date" TEXT NULL, "share" TEXT NOT NULL, "section" TEXT NOT NULL, "notice" TEXT NULL, "extra_kind" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "zakat_gifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "year_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES zakat_years (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NULL, "rate_date" TEXT NULL, "rate_view" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX history_by_investment_date ON history_entries (investment_id, date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX history_one_value_update_per_day ON history_entries (investment_id, date) WHERE kind = 'value_update'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX history_one_skip_per_plan_date ON history_entries (investment_id, kind, date) WHERE kind IN ('payout_skipped', 'value_skipped')
CREATE INDEX rates_by_pair ON rates (from_unit, to_unit, as_of)
CREATE INDEX zakat_frozen_lines_by_year ON zakat_frozen_lines (year_id, position)
CREATE INDEX zakat_gifts_by_year_date ON zakat_gifts (year_id, date)
